columnMeanings.leafIsAWrongKindOfThing: target was rewritten AND the rewritten string names a symbol in this file AND it is not the declaration the edge is about

storeResolutionSimulation.whatThisIs: the production target-binding order replayed over this 600-file index: extractLeaf, then the insert-time name match with its per-type ORDER BY, then the post-index strategies for whatever insert time left NULL
storeResolutionSimulation.whatThisIsNot: the store. is_declaration, the project-wide symbol table the post-index passes read, and SQLite's tiebreak among equally-ranked candidates are all outside a single-file index, so this counts WHICH STRING the store searches and whether any declaration in this index carries it — not which row SQLite returns.

misbindings.definition: the store matched a REWRITTEN leaf onto some declaration, and that declaration's name is not the one the edge names — so the edge is bound, to the wrong thing, which is worse than unbound

unresolved.note: bounded, not a verdict: this index is the sample and the corpus is the admitted population; an unresolved target naming a file outside the window is not a defect

declaredLimit: resolves by NAME. A name that a file outside this sample declares is counted unresolved, which conflates 'outside the window' with 'nowhere'.
